name: Exercise 1 — Familiarisation
summary: A straight corridor and four to six aircraft. Learn the scan, the label and the three instructions.
briefing: A straight corridor from the north to the south, 4 aircraft in both directions. Keep everything inside the walls, keep 1,000 ft or 3 NM between any two aircraft, and hand each one off at the exit flight level shown on its label. Press “Ask the assessor” whenever you want a prompt — that is what Exercise 1 is for.
